name: ALFILM Arab Film Festival
description: The 17th ALFILM Arab Film Festival opens with Annemarie Jacir's 'Palestine 36', set on the eve of the 1936 Palestinian uprising against British colonial rule. This year's Spotlight focuses on 'Sudan: New Projections', curated for the first time by a guest. The festival showcases contemporary Arab cinema with political and cultural resonance, offering a lens into under-represented narratives from the region during a moment of heightened geopolitical tension.
